parameters.help_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:
normal: plaintext without encryption
md5: MD5 encryption
parameters.help_zh:
加密方式：
normal：明文不加密
md5：MD5加密
parameters.name: param_type

parameters.help_en: The registration date in the format YYYYMMDD. For example, 19800101 indicates January 1, 1980
parameters.help_zh: 注册日期，格式：YYYYMMDD，例如19800101，即1980年01月01日
parameters.name: register_date

parameters.help_en:
The phone number. Valid values:
If ParamType is set to normal, pass in the phone number in plaintext.
If ParamType is set to md5, pass in the MD5-encrypted phone number
parameters.help_zh:
手机号：
paramType 传 normal 时：传入手机号明文。
paramType 传 md5 时：传入手机号密文
parameters.name: mobile

Code.description_en:
The response code. A value of 200 indicates success. Any other value indicates failure.
Important
This parameter indicates whether the API operation is called correctly. For more information about return codes, see error codes.
Check the business verification result in the fields of ResultObject
Code.description_zh:
返回码：200表示成功，其他均为失败。

3: No query result is found

查询结果：

1：有查询结果
3：无查询结果

IspName.description_en: The carrier name. China Mobile: CMCC. China Unicom: CUCC. China Telecom: CTCC

SubCode.description_en:
The detailed verification result. Valid values:

101: The registration date is equal to or later than the phone number activation date.
102: The registration date is earlier than the phone number activation date.
103: The new subscriber has not been synchronized yet.
301: Data exception or the subscriber has been deactivated
SubCode.description_zh:
核验详细结果：

101:注册时间大于等于手机号入网时间
102:注册时间小于手机号入网时间
103:新入网用户暂未同步
301:数据异常/离网用户
